title: The vanishing latent heat limit of a stochastic Stefan problem : An error estimate
summary: The purpose of this paper is to extend an article by Hilhorst, Mimura and Sch{ä}tzle [18] about the limit as the latent heat coefficient tends to zero of a two-phase Stefan problem arising in biology. We introduce a rather general additive noise white in time and colored in space, and search for the limit of the solution of the corresponding stochastic Stefan problem as the latent heat coefficient vanishes. We first prove the existence and uniqueness of the weak solution of this problem, and then study the limit of the solution as the latent heat coefficient tends to zero. Unlike in [18],…
